newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Arafat draws gun at Sri Lanka state banquet.
newsitem.headline: Arafat draws gun at Sri Lanka state banquet.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat surprised his Sri Lankan host President Chandrika Kumaratunga by pulling out a pistol at a state banquet in his honour, a newspaper reported on Wednesday.
The incident happened on Monday when Kumaratunga introduced Arafat to parliamentarian Dharmalingam Sithadthan, a former Tamil militia leader, the independent Midweek Mirror said.
Sithadthan asked Arafat jokingly: "Do you still carry a pistol as you did when you went to the U.N.?", the paper said.
"He is now the president of Palestine. He need not carry a pistol", the newspaper quoted Kumaratunga as saying on Arafat's behalf.
A grinning Arafat then drew his pistol from under his olive green fatigues, the paper said.
Arafat was in Sri Lanka on Monday and Tuesday as part of a tour of south Asian countries.
